WiT.rule: throw if the message caller's account balance does not have enough tokens to spend
WiT.fn_interface: function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success)

WiT.rule: throw if the _from account has not deliberately authorized the sender of the message via some mechanism
WiT.fn_interface: function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success)
